اكتشفوا (form VIII)
# اِكْتَشَفُوا (iktašafū) /ik.ta.ʃa.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِكْتَشَفَ (iktašafa)
# اُكْتُشِفُوا (uktušifū) /uk.tu.ʃi.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِكْتَشَفَ (iktašafa)
# اِكْتَشِفُوا (iktašifū) /ik.ta.ʃi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِكْتَشَفَ (iktašafa)
